items.summary: CTO disposition: approve containment-only execution. Admit no new site work, prototypes, research, telemetry, spend, credentials, dependencies, schedules, deployments, or domains while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and repair, measurement, security-evidence, readiness, and attribution work remain open. Retain execution-integrity, AI-cost-guardrail, and MarkItDown items as deferred specifications only; do not create duplicate requests. Continue existing records and repair-or-close work. After one slot is released, admit at most one distinct-site reversible candidate with isolated scope, deterministic validation, an existing measurable metric, explicit rollback, and no cross-site behavior. Preserve private and preview-only gates. Site revenue, margin, ROI, and causal lift remain unsupported; aggregate commission must remain unattributed.
